visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medical-grade close-up of a human skin surface covered in small, raised red papules. In the top left, the 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' logo is displayed. Large white text with a red background identifies the condition as closed comedones. The background is a pale, slightly uneven skin texture under bright, flat lighting. (2) A different close-up shows the side of a nose with prominent blackheads or open comedones. The lighting is bright and directional, highlighting the texture of the pores. White text on a pinkish background identifies the blackheads. The camera is static and extremely close, focusing on the dermatological details. (3) A female doctor with short dark hair and glasses appears on screen. She is wearing a tan blazer over a black shirt and a silver necklace with a circular pendant. She sits in a professional office with a bookshelf and a white designer bag in the background. A cartoon cat meme with question marks floats near her face. (4) The doctor demonstrates skincare techniques using two white cotton swabs. She holds them near her cheek, where a red dot graphic indicates a target area. Animated white arrows and a cartoon cat head appear to guide the viewer's attention. She moves her hands precisely, looking directly into the camera. (5) A 2D animation illustrates a hair follicle being squeezed by two swabs, releasing a yellow plug. This cut is followed by a real-life video of a large yellow sebum plug being extracted from a pore by gloved fingers. Large white captions emphasize the size of the extracted comedone as being rice-like. (6) The scene returns to the doctor holding two swabs, followed by a transition to a professional medical extraction. A metal loop tool and a needle are used by hands wearing yellow gloves to remove white material from skin pores. The lighting is very bright, focusing on the surgical precision of the act. (7) A close-up of a forehead with many small acne spots is shown. The doctor then holds a white tube of ointment and points to her face, explaining the application area. She uses her hand to gesture a broad area across her jawline, wearing a silver watch on her left wrist. (8) The final frame is a static white end card with the 'DRX' logo and clinic details. Social media icons for Line, a telephone icon, and location markers with addresses in Traditional Chinese are clearly laid out in a grey and black color scheme.
